spells.name: LORD'S JUDGEMENT
spells.hint: Damages enemy units in a selected area

spells.name: BANNER OF HEROISM
spells.hint: All your nearby squads enter into Heroic state (a squad causes 1.5x damage in Heroic state)

spells.name: SIGN OF THE ADVENT
spells.hint: Temporarily summons Lord's Avatar into the battlefield

spells.name: SUMMON STONEWORMS
spells.hint: Stoneworms damage the enemy units in a selected area

spells.name: BANNER OF BLOODLUST
spells.hint: Increases the damage caused by your units

spells.name: CATACLYSM
spells.hint: Hail of meteors causes great damage to all of the enemy's squads and strongholds and average damage to yours.

spells.name: ICE BLAST
spells.hint: Temporarily freezes the enemy squads in a selected area

spells.name: FROST ENCHANTMENT
spells.hint: Enchants your squads in a selected area to temporarily cause the max damage and get 25% less damage from the enemy attacks

spells.name: BANNER OF LIBERATION
spells.hint: Protects your nearby units from any negative magic effects

spells.name: GRAND TRANSFORMATION
spells.hint: Destroys a random half of the enemy units giving your mana and gold for the destroyed units

spells.name: TERROR
spells.hint: Пугает (переводит в состояние Испуган или снимает Героизм) вражеские отряды

spells.name: CALL OF THE GRAVE
spells.hint: Превращает 1-3 случайных живых вражеских отряда в соответствующие отряды нежити
